title: A Bonding Experience: The Open-Source New Frontier of Z-Delamination Resistance (a hobbyist's field guide to Z-strength in FDM printing without tripping over patents, including a defensive publication of PinLoK, pinned infill)
description: A lab notebook of twelve ways to make FDM prints stronger between layers without beads of different heights, judged with a 2-D bead-by-bead strength model and checked against published tests. Pinned Grid infill (PinLoK), building on Oak Ridge National Laboratory's Z-pinning, was the only method to clear a 7 % target by a wide margin in simulation (+16 to +27 % against solid infill of the same weight). All strength figures are theoretical simulation results, not measurements. Section 9 is a defensive disclosure of PinLoK and its variations; the methods are dedicated to the public. Model results only; nothing has been printed and tested yet.
